notes: TBox revision. R1: all eight member states use the West African CFA franc (XOF), issued by the BCEAO for the union; no member uses another currency. Derivability very_unlikely: the rule is the union's definition, stated directly. The three derived queries name invented states (the Republic of Varanne, the Republic of Kossandé, Tenvarre) admitted to the union in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops). Real members (Côte d'Ivoire, Benin) are not asked: their currency is stored by name. The third is an application: which currency a traveller should buy. No name leaks the answer: the union's name in English, Chinese (西非经济货币联盟) and Spanish names no currency. Revised after review: Saint-Corentin (an island state with a French name, which two models missed by answering None or euro) was replaced by the inland, neutral-named Kossandé. Migration (2026-11-11): the two indeterminate queries, their worlds and checks were dropped (TBox is determinate only); a conjunction was added; the near query moved from the BCEAO's seat (Dakar), which two models missed, to Ghana's currency: a neighbouring West African country outside the union under the same relation, whose answer (the cedi) is not the new value, so an edit that spreads to West Africa in general is caught. Plausibility: the naira is West Africa's largest currency, and the false rule is clear.
